title: auth left open (neo4j) — review required
description: auth runs with an open setting: auth_enableds*=s*false. Open binds, trust auth, and disabled protections expose the service to unauthenticated networks. This lexical rule flags the setting; the reviewer confirms isolation or hardens it.
remediation: Apply enabled auth and verify from an untrusted network.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the setting regardless of network isolation.
